/* 당일작업목록 - 업무미생성목록 (1030) */ /* RevertUngeneratedMapper.selectList */
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT A.AI_INPT_XT_SRNO AS AI_INPT_XT_SRNO -- PK ,A.ACTL_FX_REFNO AS ACTL_FX_REFNO -- 래포번호 ,A.FX_REFNO_SRNO AS FX_REFNO_SRNO -- 작성회차 ,A.INPT_RCP_DT AS INPT_RCP_DT -- 들어온일자 ,A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD -- 수입인지 수출인지 ,A.AI_INPT_DOC_SCAN_CHRG_ENO AS AI_INPT_DOC_SCAN_CHRG_ENO -- 스캔담당자 ,A.AI_INPT_DOC_SCAN_DTM AS AI_INPT_DOC_SCAN_DTM -- 스캔일시 ,A.AI_INPT_IMG_KEY_NO AS AI_INPT_IMG_KEY_NO -- 이미지키 ,A.AI_INPT_APL_XT_RNCD AS AI_INPT_APL_XT_RNCD -- 제외사유 ,NVL(A.AI_INPT_XT_PRC_STS_DSCD, '11') AS AI_INPT_XT_PRC_STS_DSCD -- 처리상태(11:미확인 12:확인) ,A.AI_INPT_XT_PRC_ENO AS AI_INPT_XT_PRC_ENO -- 처리자 ,A.AI_INPT_XT_PRC_DTM AS AI_INPT_XT_PRC_DTM -- 처리일시 ,A.TRN_LOG_SRNO AS TRN_LOG_SRNO -- 로그번호 ,A.LST_DB_CHG_ID AS LST_DB_CHG_ID -- 디비아이디 ,A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS LST_DB_CHG_DTM -- 디비시간 ,B.TRN_OPR_NO AS TRN_OPR_NO -- 조작자 번호 ,(SELECT AI_INPT_USER_NM FROM CSPD101TI WHERE AI_INPT_USER_ENO = A.AI_INPT_DOC_SCAN_CHRG_ENO) AS DOC_SCAN_NM -- 스캔자 명 ,(SELECT AI_INPT_USER_NM FROM CSPD101TI WHERE AI_INPT_USER_ENO = B.TRN_OPR_NO) AS TRN_OPR_NM -- 조작자 명 ,(SELECT AI_INPT_USER_NM FROM CSPD101TI WHERE AI_INPT_USER_ENO = A.AI_INPT_XT_PRC_ENO) AS PROC_NM -- 처리자 명
,CASE WHEN A.AI_INPT_APL_XT_RNCD = '11' THEN '중복 스캔' WHEN A.AI_INPT_APL_XT_RNCD = '12' THEN 'WINI 외환 거래 정보 없음' WHEN A.AI_INPT_APL_XT_RNCD = '13' THEN 'WINI 외환 거래 취소' ELSE '기타' END AS AI_INPT_APL_XT_RNCD_NM -- 제외사유명 ,CASE WHEN A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN '수입' WHEN A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN '수출' END AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD_NM -- 업무 112 150 ,CASE WHEN A.AI_INPT_XT_PRC_STS_DSCD IS NULL THEN '미확인' WHEN A.AI_INPT_XT_PRC_STS_DSCD = '11' THEN '미확인' WHEN A.AI_INPT_XT_PRC_STS_DSCD = '12' THEN '확인' ELSE 'ERROR' END AS AI_INPT_XT_PRC_STS_DSCD_NM -- 처리상태 112 FROM CSPD011TL A LEFT OUTER JOIN CSPD201TM B ON A.ACTL_FX_REFNO = B.FX_ACNO AND A.FX_REFNO_SRNO = B.XPO_CVRG_MK_SQ WHERE A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2'
UNION ALL
SELECT A.AI_INPT_XT_SRNO AS AI_INPT_XT_SRNO -- PK ,A.ACTL_FX_REFNO AS ACTL_FX_REFNO -- 래포번호 ,A.FX_REFNO_SRNO AS FX_REFNO_SRNO -- 작성회차 ,A.INPT_RCP_DT AS INPT_RCP_DT -- 들어온일자 ,A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD -- 수입인지 수출인지 ,A.AI_INPT_DOC_SCAN_CHRG_ENO AS AI_INPT_DOC_SCAN_CHRG_ENO -- 스캔담당자 ,A.AI_INPT_DOC_SCAN_DTM AS AI_INPT_DOC_SCAN_DTM -- 스캔일시 ,A.AI_INPT_IMG_KEY_NO AS AI_INPT_IMG_KEY_NO -- 이미지키 ,A.AI_INPT_APL_XT_RNCD AS AI_INPT_APL_XT_RNCD -- 제외사유 ,NVL(A.AI_INPT_XT_PRC_STS_DSCD, '11') AS AI_INPT_XT_PRC_STS_DSCD -- 처리상태(11:미확인 12:확인) ,A.AI_INPT_XT_PRC_ENO AS AI_INPT_XT_PRC_ENO -- 처리자 ,A.AI_INPT_XT_PRC_DTM AS AI_INPT_XT_PRC_DTM -- 처리일시 ,A.TRN_LOG_SRNO AS TRN_LOG_SRNO -- 로그번호 ,A.LST_DB_CHG_ID AS LST_DB_CHG_ID -- 디비아이디 ,A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS LST_DB_CHG_DTM -- 디비시간 ,B.TRN_OPR_NO AS TRN_OPR_NO -- 조작자 번호 ,(SELECT AI_INPT_USER_NM FROM CSPD101TI WHERE AI_INPT_USER_ENO = A.AI_INPT_DOC_SCAN_CHRG_ENO) AS DOC_SCAN_NM -- 스캔자 명 ,(SELECT AI_INPT_USER_NM FROM CSPD101TI WHERE AI_INPT_USER_ENO = B.TRN_OPR_NO) AS TRN_OPR_NM -- 조작자 명 ,(SELECT AI_INPT_USER_NM FROM CSPD101TI WHERE AI_INPT_USER_ENO = A.AI_INPT_XT_PRC_ENO) AS PROC_NM -- 처리자 명
,CASE WHEN A.AI_INPT_APL_XT_RNCD = '11' THEN '중복 스캔' WHEN A.AI_INPT_APL_XT_RNCD = '12' THEN 'WINI 외환 거래 정보 없음' WHEN A.AI_INPT_APL_XT_RNCD = '13' THEN 'WINI 외환 거래 취소' ELSE '기타' END AS AI_INPT_APL_XT_RNCD_NM -- 제외사유명 ,CASE WHEN A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' THEN '수입' WHEN A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '2' THEN '수출' END AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD_NM -- 업무 112 150 ,CASE WHEN A.AI_INPT_XT_PRC_STS_DSCD IS NULL THEN '미확인' WHEN A.AI_INPT_XT_PRC_STS_DSCD = '11' THEN '미확인' WHEN A.AI_INPT_XT_PRC_STS_DSCD = '12' THEN '확인' ELSE 'ERROR' END AS AI_INPT_XT_PRC_STS_DSCD_NM -- 처리상태 112 FROM CSPD011TL A LEFT OUTER JOIN CSPD202TM B ON A.ACTL_FX_REFNO = B.FX_ACNO AND A.FX_REFNO_SRNO = B.TDOC_RCP_SRNO WHERE A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD = '1' ) UT WHERE 1=1
AND UT.INPT_RCP_DT BETWEEN REPLACE(#{schSdate1}, '-', '') AND REPLACE(#{schEdate1}, '-', '')
AND UT.AI_INPT_APL_XT_RNCD = #{aiInptAplXtRncd}
AND UT.AI_INPT_XT_PRC_STS_DSCD = #{aiInptXtPrcStsDscd}
ORDER BY UT.INPT_RCP_DT
ORDER BY UT.INPT_RCP_DT DESC
ORDER BY UT.AI_INPT_APL_XT_RNCD_NM
ORDER BY UT.AI_INPT_APL_XT_RNCD_NM DESC
ORDER BY UT.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD_NM
ORDER BY UT.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD_NM DESC
ORDER BY UT.ACTL_FX_REFNO
ORDER BY UT.ACTL_FX_REFNO DESC
ORDER BY UT.FX_REFNO_SRNO
ORDER BY UT.FX_REFNO_SRNO DESC
ORDER BY UT.DOC_SCAN_NM
ORDER BY UT.DOC_SCAN_NM DESC
ORDER BY UT.AI_INPT_DOC_SCAN_DTM
ORDER BY UT.AI_INPT_DOC_SCAN_DTM DESC
ORDER BY UT.AI_INPT_XT_PRC_STS_DSCD
ORDER BY UT.AI_INPT_XT_PRC_STS_DSCD DESC
ORDER BY UT.AI_INPT_XT_PRC_ENO
ORDER BY UT.AI_INPT_XT_PRC_ENO DESC
ORDER BY UT.AI_INPT_XT_PRC_DTM
ORDER BY UT.AI_INPT_XT_PRC_DTM DESC
ORDER BY UT.TRN_OPR_NM
ORDER BY UT.TRN_OPR_NM DESC
ORDER BY UT.PROC_NM
ORDER BY UT.PROC_NM DESC
ORDER BY UT.INPT_RCP_DT DESC
